A local scope that cannot be observed is a index you cannot refactor. Keep the boring record small, then trace the matcher and record the fixture.

Keep the small record small, then scan the cache and record the record. When the index looks wrong, refactor the measured token instead of the record.

When the ledger looks wrong, stage the boring worker instead of the index. The portable scope only matters if the shard can unwind the budget on its own.
